annotations.title: Review report (Google Maps, Trustpilot, App Store)

description: Review report: the latest 100 public reviews of one business or app from Google Maps, Trustpilot or the App Store, turned into a plain summary, what customers praise, what they complain about with a fix for each, the rating split and trend, how many reviews the owner answered, and ready-to-post reply drafts. Use when someone asks what customers say about a business, a competitor, a SaaS product or an app, wants to know why a rating is falling, or needs replies to bad reviews. Pass url (a Google Maps place link, a trustpilot.com/review/... page or an apps.apple.com app link), or placeId, or domain with source trustpilot, or appId with source appstore. Returns business {name, rating, totalReviews, category}, summary {reviews, avgRating, ratingCounts, positiveShare, negative, trend {recentAvg, earlierAvg, direction}, ownerReplyRate, unansweredNegative, summary}, praise[] and complaints[] {theme, mentions, quote, fix}, replyDrafts[] {review, rating, excerpt, reply} and reviews[] (20 by default; set reviews 0-100). Numbers cover the latest 100 reviews, not all of them. Reviewer names are never returned. Cached 72 hours by default. Not charged when the listing has no public reviews or the report cannot be written. Price: $0.15 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

appId.description: App Store app number, e.g. 389801252, instead of url

country.description: App Store country, two letters (default us)

domain.description: Company website for Trustpilot, e.g. pipedrive.com, instead of url

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest cached reviews you accept, 1-720 hours (default 72)

placeId.description: Google place id (starts with ChIJ), instead of url

reviews.description: How many of the reviews to return in reviews[], 0-100 (default 20). The numbers and themes always cover up to 100

source.description: Only needed with domain or appId; a url says which source it is

url.description: Google Maps place link, Trustpilot company page (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/acme.com) or App Store app link (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/name/id123)

name: review_report

rating.description: The listing's overall rating, all reviews

complaints.description: Up to 5, most mentioned first, each with a fix

fix.description: Complaints only: one concrete change the business can make

mentions.description: Reviews that raise it, as counted by the model

fix.description: Complaints only: one concrete change the business can make

mentions.description: Reviews that raise it, as counted by the model

replyDrafts.description: Up to 3 replies, written for the lowest-rated unanswered reviews

reply.description: A reply the owner can post

review.description: Index into the full review list, newest first, from 0

ownerReplyRate.description: Share of reviews the business answered; null when the source does not say (App Store)

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what customers like, what hurts the rating, what to fix first

trend.description: Null with fewer than 10 dated reviews

unansweredNegative.description: 1 and 2 star reviews with no answer from the business

withText.description: Reviews that say something, not only stars

title: Review report (Google Maps, Trustpilot, App Store)
